lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid of vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs to form a defined grid of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.
